milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to 'find' the iron door, which means the player must navigate close enough to observe it and be facing toward it. The iron door is at spawn-relative position (8, 1, 6) on the south face of the stone brick building. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the door.
